title: Preserve the retry-disable policy
task: Implement merge_retry_options in src/retry_policy.py according to the durable retry policy established in the preceding session. Keep the public function signature and run verification.
predecessor_record: Durable retry policy: merge_retry_options returns a new mapping and never mutates either input. A request value for max_attempts overrides the default when it is an integer from 1 through 6. A request value of 0 explicitly disables retries and must remain 0. A request value of None means use the default. A missing request mapping behaves as an empty mapping.
